name: Spider
description: A devious mastermind. XP trigger: You addressed a challenge with calculation or conspiracy.

features.name: Foresight
features.description: Two times per score you can assist a teammate without paying stress. Tell us how you prepared for this.

features.name: Calculating
features.description: Due to your careful planning, during downtime, you may give yourself or another crew member +1 downtime action.

features.name: Connected
features.description: During downtime, you get +1 result level when you acquire an asset or reduce heat.

features.name: Functioning Vice
features.description: When you indulge your vice, you may adjust the dice outcome by 1 or 2 (up or down). An ally who joins in your vice may do the same.

features.name: Ghost Contract
features.description: When you shake on a deal, you and your partner -- human or otherwise -- both bear a mark of your oath. If either breaks the contract, they take level 3 harm, "Cursed."

features.name: Jail Bird
features.description: When incarcerated, your wanted level counts as 1 less, your Tier as 1 more, and you gain +1 faction status with a faction you help on the inside (in addition to your incarceration roll).

features.name: Mastermind
features.description: You may expend your special armor to protect a teammate, or to push yourself when you gather information or work on a long-term project.

features.name: Weaving the Web
features.description: You gain +1d to Consort when you gather information on a target for a score. You get +1d to the engagement roll for that operation.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
